label: Generated Code Quality Issues
operational_definition: Structural, functional, non-functional, risk-related, or generation-specific deficiencies in LLM-generated code.
include_rule: Use only its eight final child dimensions as Sankey targets.
exclude_rule: Do not code benchmark validity or model capability without an observable generated-code quality outcome.

label: Correctness
operational_definition: Generated code fails to implement intended semantics or to execute validly.
include_rule: Include syntax or compilation errors; logical or runtime failures; and improper API or dependency use.
exclude_rule: Exclude response-level instruction or format departure when the delivered code is not itself shown incorrect.

label: Security
operational_definition: Generated code contains weaknesses permitting unauthorized access disclosure alteration or unsafe execution.
include_rule: Include externally triggered vulnerabilities and inherent insecure implementation patterns.
exclude_rule: Exclude licensing privacy or harmful-intent issues without an exploitable software weakness.

label: Compliance
operational_definition: Generated code violates legal ethical or regulatory constraints.
include_rule: Include malicious or toxic code; improper disclosure of personal information; copyright or license violations; and discriminatory behavior.
exclude_rule: Exclude ordinary functional defects or security weaknesses with no compliance outcome reported.

label: Robustness
operational_definition: Generated code cannot remain stable under abnormal inputs boundary conditions or non-malicious runtime disruptions.
include_rule: Include missing validation fault tolerance exception handling or stability under perturbation.
exclude_rule: Exclude adversarial exploitability coded as Security and ordinary incorrect output under standard input coded as Correctness.

label: Maintainability
operational_definition: Generated code is difficult to modify extend or reuse without introducing risk.
include_rule: Include excessive coupling weak modularity monolithic structure poor extensibility and low reusability.
exclude_rule: Exclude surface readability problems without an evolvability or structural maintenance consequence.

label: Understandability
operational_definition: Humans have difficulty comprehending the generated code's logic intent or structure.
include_rule: Include unclear naming missing or misleading comments unexplained constants and opaque expressions.
exclude_rule: Exclude structural extensibility problems whose reported consequence is maintenance rather than comprehension.

label: Efficiency
operational_definition: Generated code unnecessarily consumes time or memory resources.
include_rule: Include suboptimal algorithms excessive runtime memory waste or avoidable resource use.
exclude_rule: Exclude mere output length or redundant response text without a measured or described resource consequence.

label: Generation Derailment
operational_definition: The generated response departs from the task-directed course needed to provide a usable code deliverable.
include_rule: Include instruction or constraint misalignment incomplete or unrequested response content gratuitous repetition and unusable scaffolding.
exclude_rule: Exclude incorrect but task-directed code and output length alone without response-level loss of usability.

label: Training Data Quality Issues
operational_definition: Intrinsic flaws in pre-training or fine-tuning corpora relevant to code-generation quality.
include_rule: Use only the thirteen final leaf categories as Sankey sources.
exclude_rule: Exclude prompt decoding model-size architecture and retrieval effects unless a training or fine-tuning data factor is identified.

label: Code Attribute Quality Issues
operational_definition: Defects localized within individual code samples in the training dataset.
include_rule: Use a child node when the evidence concerns an intrinsic property of code samples.
exclude_rule: Exclude corpus-level distributions and defects found only in surrounding text.

label: Correctness
operational_definition: Training code samples contain syntax logical functionality API or dependency defects.
include_rule: Include outdated or incorrect APIs incomplete executable fragments syntax defects and buggy logic in code samples.
exclude_rule: Exclude incomplete natural-language instructions and corpus age when no incorrect code property is identified.

label: Security
operational_definition: Training code samples contain vulnerabilities credentials or high-risk implementation patterns.
include_rule: Include insecure idioms unsafe APIs hard-coded secrets and exploitable code defects.
exclude_rule: Exclude privacy or license content with no code-security weakness.

label: Compliance
operational_definition: Training code samples violate legal ethical or regulatory requirements.
include_rule: Include copyrighted or restrictively licensed code and discriminatory or otherwise non-compliant code logic.
exclude_rule: Exclude textual copyright privacy or harmful content outside code samples.

label: Robustness
operational_definition: Training code samples lack fault tolerance for abnormal inputs boundary cases or runtime variation.
include_rule: Include missing boundary checks validation exception handling and fragile sample behavior.
exclude_rule: Exclude ordinary logic errors not tied to non-standard conditions.

label: Maintainability
operational_definition: Training code samples have structures that are difficult to modify extend or reuse.
include_rule: Include excessive coupling monolithic design weak modularization poor extensibility and maintenance-oriented code smells.
exclude_rule: Exclude readability-only issues with no structural maintenance implication.

label: Understandability
operational_definition: Training code samples express logic or intent unclearly.
include_rule: Include poor naming misleading or absent comments unexplained constants and obscure expressions.
exclude_rule: Exclude comment-code supervision mismatch when the issue is the paired instruction rather than code readability.

label: Efficiency
operational_definition: Training code samples contain resource-wasting or algorithmically suboptimal implementations.
include_rule: Include high-complexity algorithms poor memory management and avoidable resource use in samples.
exclude_rule: Exclude training cost data volume and response verbosity unless inefficient code itself is the data property.

label: Non-Code Attribute Quality Issues
operational_definition: Defects in non-code textual data or macro-level properties of the corpus.
include_rule: Use a child node for textual content distributions redundancy diversity contamination or low-value data.
exclude_rule: Exclude intrinsic code-sample defects.

label: Compliance and Security Risks (Textual)
operational_definition: Non-code textual training content is harmful copyright-infringing or privacy-leaking.
include_rule: Include illegal or harmful text unauthorized protected text and personal or confidential information in text.
exclude_rule: Exclude equivalent defects localized in code samples which belong to code-attribute Compliance or Security.

label: Distribution Imbalance Issues
operational_definition: The corpus is uneven across languages domains resources data types tasks or difficulty.
include_rule: Include disproportionate representation that is explicitly related to uneven code-generation performance.
exclude_rule: Exclude simple lack of coverage without a comparative skew or imbalance.

label: Redundancy Issues
operational_definition: The corpus contains duplicate near-duplicate or excessively repetitive samples.
include_rule: Include copied templates boilerplate repeated files and repetitive synthetic data when redundancy is the operative property.
exclude_rule: Exclude benchmark overlap coded as contamination and general lack of variety without duplication.

label: Inadequate Diversity
operational_definition: The corpus insufficiently covers scenarios domains edge cases environments or solution forms.
include_rule: Include restricted domain task language or solution coverage explicitly connected to limited downstream behavior.
exclude_rule: Exclude imbalance when evidence is specifically comparative prevalence and duplication when repeated samples drive the effect.

label: Data Contamination Risks
operational_definition: Training data overlap with evaluation benchmarks or otherwise leak test solutions.
include_rule: Include benchmark examples solutions or near-duplicates in pre-training or fine-tuning corpora.
exclude_rule: Exclude ordinary within-training duplication and memorization with no evaluation-data overlap.

label: Low-Value Data
operational_definition: Training data contributes little useful learning signal or introduces noise and error.
include_rule: Include meaningless malformed low-information erroneous incomplete or instruction-code-misaligned text and metadata.
exclude_rule: Exclude intrinsic code defects that can be coded to a code-attribute category and distributional shortcomings better coded elsewhere.
